items.title: Vercel Labs Open-Sources agent-desktop for Agent Computer Use
items.description:
Vercel Labs released agent-desktop, an Apache-2.0 Rust CLI that gives any AI agent computer use on macOS, Windows and Linux by reading OS accessibility trees and acting on stable refs instead of pixels.

The post
items.summary: Vercel Labs open-sourced agent-desktop, an Apache-2.0 Rust CLI enabling AI agents to interact with computers across macOS, Windows, and Linux by reading accessibility trees. This tool aims to improve AI integration and usability on different operating systems without relying on pixel-based interactions, marking a step forward in accessible AI technology.
items.summary_detailed: Vercel Labs released agent-desktop, an open-source Apache-2.0 Rust CLI tool, allowing AI agents to interact with computers on macOS, Windows, and Linux by reading accessibility trees rather than relying on pixel interactions.
